neighbours.label: a past participle completing a passive construction (was driven, were created, then made); the same verb in active voice stays quiet
fire: The stolen car was driven across the border at night.
Several new species were discovered in the cave last year.
The final decision was made by the board on Friday.
Thousands of letters were written by soldiers during the war.
The old bridge was destroyed in the flood of 1927.
Most of the paintings were created in his Paris studio.
The treaty was signed by both leaders in Geneva.
The speeches given at the ceremony were short and moving.
quiet: The thief drove the stolen car across the border at night.
Scientists discovered several new species in the cave last year.
The board made the final decision on Friday.
Soldiers wrote thousands of letters during the war.
The flood of 1927 destroyed the old bridge.
He created most of the paintings in his Paris studio.
Both leaders signed the treaty in Geneva.
The mayor gave short and moving speeches at the ceremony.

notes: Top: 'speeches then made', 'Jeep was driven', 'works that were created', 'erbracht werden', 'words uttered in'. Near misses are the same events in active voice.
